children.text: On a geothermal project, the rig is not just a means of execution. It influences the pace, precision, safety and the ability to react to the real conditions encountered in the ground.
The rig isn't everything, but it matters enormously
A good rig makes it possible to better control progress, maintain a high standard on site and limit unnecessary lost time. It also gives more room to adapt when conditions change.
Why this tool is relevant for geothermal energy
On vertical geothermal projects, repeatability, stability and productivity are essential. A well-sized, well-operated rig contributes directly to the overall quality of the final result.
At WDD, the equipment fleet is designed to deliver with consistency, method and productivity.
